item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
What's New in Tomik 1.0.0

  • Sparkle 2 Auto-Update: Seamlessly check for updates and update Tomik directly from GitHub Releases.
  • Dedicated Settings & Stats Window: Redesigned management window with daily targets, volume controls, sound themes, and unicode font selections.
  • Kawaii Menu Bar Experience: Clean status bar timer with customizable theme colors, break suggestions, and confetti celebrations.
  • Multilingual Support: Full support for Vietnamese, English, and Japanese.
